AiCaseAvailableEntry.title: AiCaseAvailableEntry

description:
``data/ai-cases/activity/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json`` — a day's significant AI-case docket entries.

Written by ``watchlist-refresh`` for the entries a refresh found that the
stored docket lacked and that the rule (:data:`fedcourtsai.ai_activity.ACTIVITY_RULE`)
keeps, and for the entries the stored docket already held whose documents
became readable and that the availability rule
(:data:`fedcourtsai.ai_activity.AVAILABILITY_RULE`) keeps. Identifiers,
dates, kinds, counts and links only: no docket text is copied.

available.description: Entries filed earlier whose documents became readable this day, oldest filing first. A day with neither list has no file.
available.title: Available

available_rule.description: The availability rule's label; present exactly when `available` is.
available_rule.title: Available Rule

day.description: The UTC day the refresh found these entries.
day.title: Day

entries.description: The day's new significant entries, oldest filing first.
entries.title: Entries

title: AiCaseActivity
